overview.desc: Open jobs, your pending scorecards and the latest candidates.
overview.aiNote: AI in Hiring only assists: it reads resumes and writes summaries. It never decides on a candidate; people do.

jobs.desc: Every job has its own hiring team, pipeline stages and application form.
jobs.emptyBody: Create a job from a template, add your hiring team and publish it on your careers page.
jobs.activeCount: {count, plural, one {# active candidate} other {# active candidates}}
jobs.emptyBodyMember: An admin creates jobs and adds you to their hiring team.

jobNew.desc: Start from a template or a blank job. You can change everything afterwards.

job.title: Job title
job.salaryPublic: Show the salary on the careers page
job.confidentialHelp: Only the hiring team and admins see it. It stays off the careers page, the job feed and search.

jobEditor.markdownHelp: Use ## for headings and - for bullet points.
jobEditor.deleteBody: The job and its applications are deleted. Candidates keep their other applications.

questions.help: Questions candidates answer when they apply. A knock-out question flags the application when the answer is not the expected one. A person still decides: nothing is rejected on its own.
questions.label: Question
questions.autoReject: Reject automatically when the answer does not qualify (the candidate is not told; you can reactivate them)

team.help: Recruiters and hiring managers see every candidate of this job. Interviewers only see the candidates they are asked to evaluate. Admins see everything.

stages.help: The first stage receives new applications and one stage marks the hire. Stages with criteria ask the job's interviewers and hiring manager for a scorecard when a candidate enters them.
stages.name: Stage
stages.kitPlaceholder: One question per line. Interviewers see them above the scorecard.

share.title: Share link
share.help: A short link from Link to this job post, with UTM parameters so the source shows up on each application.

pipeline.addedDuplicate: This email already belonged to a candidate: the application was added to the existing profile.
pipeline.notOnTeamTitle: You are not on this job's hiring team
pipeline.interviewerBody: As an interviewer you see the candidates you are asked to evaluate in your overview.
pipeline.notOnTeamBody: Ask a recruiter or an admin to add you to the hiring team.
pipeline.emptyBody: Applications from the careers page land here. You can also add a candidate yourself.

candidates.desc: Candidates of the jobs where you are on the hiring team.
candidates.search: Search by name, email or tag
candidates.emptyBody: Publish a job and share the careers page, or add candidates to a job by hand.

apply.name: Full name
apply.resumeHelp: PDF, DOC or DOCX, up to 10 MB.
apply.consentDefault: I agree that {company} stores and processes my data to evaluate my application.

bulk.done: {done, plural, one {# updated} other {# updated}}{failed, plural, =0 {} other {, # could not be updated}}.
bulk.title: Bulk actions

reasons.culture: Not the right fit for the team

profile.notePlaceholder: Leave a note for the hiring team
profile.repliesOff: Replies by email do not come back to the timeline until an inbound email domain is configured (CHAT_INBOUND_DOMAIN).
profile.noEvaluators: Nobody is assigned to evaluate yet.
profile.noConsent: Added by the team, no consent from the candidate on file.
profile.keepConsent: Keep beyond the retention period (the candidate agreed)
profile.deleteTitle: Delete all data of this candidate?
profile.deleteBody: {name}'s applications, resume, timeline, scorecards and offers are deleted for good. Use it when a candidate asks to be forgotten.
profile.unverifiedDoc: sent with a new application, unverified
profile.hireUndone: Moved out of Hired. The People profile stays: HR was told.

score.hidden: {count, plural, one {# scorecard from another evaluator is hidden until you submit yours.} other {# scorecards from other evaluators are hidden until you submit yours.}}
score.locked: You already submitted your scorecard for this stage.

interviews.waiting: The candidate has not picked a time yet
interviews.sent: Scheduling link sent to the candidate.
interviews.help: The candidate picks a time when every evaluator of {stage} is free, from Cal. Cal sends the calendar invites and the reminders.
interviews.sendEmail: Email the link to the candidate

offers.waitingApproval: A hiring manager or an admin has to approve it.
offers.title: Position title
offers.help: The letter comes from your offer letter template. The hiring manager or an admin approves it before it goes out. The candidate accepts by typing their name.
offers.created: Offer created. It waits for approval.

templates.subject: Subject
templates.desc: Emails to candidates and the offer letter. Without one of your own, Hiring uses a default in the careers page language.
templates.emptyBody: Hiring uses its default acknowledgement, rejection, interview and offer emails until you add your own.
templates.name: Name
templates.defaultsNote: The newest template of each type is the one Hiring uses by default.
templates.scopeHelp: Templates for all jobs (including the automatic acknowledgement) are managed by admins. A job template is used only by that job.

ai.title: AI assistance
ai.note: AI only assists: it reads the resume and writes a neutral summary. It never decides on a candidate.

reports.desc: Numbers for the candidates you can see.
reports.median: Median {days} days · {hires, plural, one {# hire} other {# hires}}
reports.activeCandidates: {count, plural, one {# active candidate} other {# active candidates}}

settings.title: Hiring settings
settings.desc: Your careers page, candidate emails and data retention.
settings.adminOnly: Only admins can change these settings.
settings.brandHelp: The logo comes from your workspace. Without a color here, the page uses the brand color from Cal.
settings.autoAck: Send an acknowledgement email when someone applies
settings.repliesOn: Candidate replies come back to their timeline.
settings.repliesOff: Replies do not come back yet: they need an inbound email domain (CHAT_INBOUND_DOMAIN, the same one Chat uses).
settings.retentionHelp: Hired candidates and those who agreed to stay for future openings are kept.
settings.consentText: Consent text on the application form
settings.membersCreateJobs: Members with Hiring can create jobs (otherwise only admins)
settings.approvalsHelp: Choose people in order. Each one decides after the previous one and joins the team of that job as hiring manager, so they can see what they approve. Nobody approves their own request: if that leaves nobody, the owner or another admin is added. With nobody chosen, no approval is needed.
settings.feed: Job feed in XML, for aggregators that accept one:

errors.unauthorized: You do not have access to Hiring in this workspace.
errors.forbidden: You do not have permission to do that.
errors.not_found: It does not exist or you cannot see it.
errors.invalid_handle: Use 2 to 40 lowercase letters, numbers or dashes.
errors.invalid_salary: The minimum salary is above the maximum.
errors.duplicate_question: Two questions share the same id.
errors.stages_applied_first: The first stage has to be of type Applied, and only one.
errors.stages_one_hired: Exactly one stage has to be of type Hired.
errors.stage_not_empty: A stage you removed still has candidates. Move them first.
errors.invalid_stage: Pick a stage of this job.
errors.resume_type: The resume has to be a PDF, DOC or DOCX file.
errors.resume_size: The resume is too large (4 MB at most).
errors.offer_open: There is already an open offer for this application.
errors.offer_not_approved: The offer has to be approved before it is sent.
errors.invalid_state: The offer changed in the meantime. Reload.
errors.cal_handle_missing: Set your public Cal address (Cal settings) to send scheduling links.
errors.cal_invalid_input: An evaluator is not a member of this workspace.
errors.no_resume_text: There is no readable resume text (only PDFs are read).
errors.ai_disabled: AI is not available in this workspace.
errors.quota_exceeded: The AI quota for this month is used up.
errors.rate_limited: Too many requests. Try again in a minute.
errors.ai_failed: The AI could not answer. Try again.
errors.link_unavailable: You need Link to create short links.
errors.docs_unavailable: You need Docs to import a page.
errors.not_on_team: Evaluators have to be on the job's hiring team.
errors.stage_without_scorecard: This stage has no scorecard criteria.
errors.invalid_criterion: That criterion is not part of this stage.
errors.not_assigned_stage: You can only score the stage you were asked to evaluate.
errors.scorecard_locked: Your scorecard for this stage is already submitted.
errors.own_offer: Someone else has to approve an offer you prepared.
errors.auth_required: The email could not be verified.
errors.offer_in_sign: This offer went out for signature with Sign. Follow it from the envelope; voiding it brings the offer back to approved.
errors.approval_required: This job needs approval before it can be published.
errors.approvals_off: No approvers are set in Settings.
errors.not_your_step: It is not your turn to decide.
errors.email_limit: Daily email limit reached for this address or workspace. Try again tomorrow.
errors.csv_columns: The file needs a header row with Name and Email columns.
errors.duplicate_in_file: This email is repeated in the file.
errors.file_too_large: The file is too large (2 MB at most).
errors.invalid_field: That value does not fit the field type.
errors.no_other_approver: Someone other than you has to approve this, and there is nobody else. Invite another admin, or remove the approvers in Hiring settings.
errors.close_to_edit: This job is published. Close it to change the title or salary, show a hidden salary or turn off confidential, then request approval.

esign.hint: The candidate signs the letter as a PDF with an audit trail. When they sign, the offer is accepted.
esign.error: Could not send it with Sign.

approvals.title: Approval to publish
approvals.fallback: Added because nobody else would review it
approvals.reassigned: Reassigned: the approver left the workspace
approvals.statusStale: Changed after approval: request approval again
approvals.noApprover: Nobody else can approve this. Add an approver or another admin, then request again.

import.title: Import candidates
import.help: A CSV with a header row. Name and Email are required; also Phone, Location, Headline, Source and Tags (separated by |). No email goes out to anyone. Check you may store their data before importing.
import.file: CSV file (2 MB, 500 rows at most)
import.summary: {valid, plural, one {# candidate} other {# candidates}} ready to import.
import.done: Imported: {added} new, {existing} already on this job.

copy.title: Copy {name} to another job
copy.move: Move: withdraw from the current job
copy.help: The new job starts at its first stage and its team can see this candidate.
copy.already: This candidate is already on that job.

merge.title: Merge candidates
merge.body: Everything from {drop} moves to {keep}: applications, timeline, documents and tags. This cannot be undone.
merge.visibility: The team of each job will see this person with all their applications, documents and details, including from a confidential job.

candidateFields.title: Candidate fields
candidateFields.help: Your own fields on each candidate, such as notice period. Protected fields are seen only by recruiters, hiring managers and admins.
candidateFields.name: Field name
candidateFields.protected: Only for recruiters and hiring managers
